ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. When supplied and found, the existing persona is updated.

Name.description: Unique technical name. AI profiles, profile templates and chat interactions link to the persona by this name, so it cannot change once created. A persona with the same name is updated.

DisplayText.description: How the persona is shown in editors.

Description.description: Helps editors choose the right persona.

Instructions.description: Liquid persona instructions placed first in the system message of every profile or interaction that links to the persona. Required.

AssistantName.description: The name the assistant uses for itself. The model is told its name, and chat screens show it on assistant messages.

Language.description: BCP-47 language tag, such as en-US, used as the speech language when nothing else sets one.

VoiceName.description: Provider-specific voice the persona speaks with.

VoiceDeploymentName.description: Deployment the voice was chosen from. The voice is only used on deployments of the same provider.

AvatarUrl.description: Optional avatar image URL shown next to assistant messages.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve during import.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the persona.

Properties.description: Additional properties stored with the persona.

personas.description: The AI personas to create or update.
